purpose: Current-source paired validation-only SolarEnergy matrix for the AutoCon-connected MambaTSv3 candidate and strong baselines.
research_question: Does MambaTSv3AutoCon remain competitive with strong baselines on the existing SolarEnergy coordinate under a single frozen contract?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics, predictions, or held-out release is permitted.
claim_boundary: This matrix can document SolarEnergy as a success or failure boundary only; it cannot establish universal forecasting, AutoCon causality, or speed superiority.

required_before_launch: verify SolarEnergy hash and exact 18-job expansion
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate, baseline set, optimizer, normalization, source snapshot and budget are frozen before launch.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the AutoCon objective and prediction-connected representation fusion.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: External baselines receive no candidate-only AutoCon or Mamba flags.

phases.name: candidate_solar_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate on SolarEnergy H96.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report paired validation deltas only; a held-out test release requires a separate plan and approval.

stopping_rules: Do not convert validation results into test claims.
If any coordinate is incomplete or has test artifacts, stop and mark the matrix invalid.
A favorable Solar result requires an independent full-budget confirmation before any publication claim.
